rule: 30-minute one-way walking limit. Durations are routing estimates, not official measurements: official addresses were geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim and foot routes were computed with the OSRM foot profile on the FOSSGIS routing server (routing.openstreetmap.de/routed-foot). Same-property and in-building pairs are 0 minutes (the poker room is inside the hotel; the official indoor route text is on the row). Every pair carries Google and Apple Maps links so you can re-walk it independently before relying on it.

method: Routed on 2026-11-16 (session arena/f0816fab-poker2, dataset data/site/walking.json, same method) for 10 of the 12 pairs, and freshly on 2026-11-17 (session arena/18aba6dd-poker2) for the two pairs that dataset did not cover (The Cosmopolitan -> Venetian poker room, 22.6 min / 1,692 m; Bellagio -> Cosmopolitan, 16.5 min / 1,235 m). OSRM returns walking durations for a typical pace; they are estimates, and the Google/Apple Maps links on each row are the confirmation path.
